skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept of land finance, the basic differences between land taxes and other financial revenues from land, and various types of land prices in implementing land finance.
Recognize the concepts, principles, and characteristics of land finance and land prices in implementing land finance.
Analyze and make decisions in tasks related to land finance and resolve issues arising in specific situations of the land finance implementation process.

Apply knowledge to collect and determine various types of land prices in the process of fulfilling land finance obligations; calculate financial obligations on land when implementing land transactions.
Analyze real-world situations related to land finance.
Summarize and integrate research content and materials on land finance.
Actively participate in group work, choose issues, methods, tools, and research materials for land finance.
